response.sql: SELECT AVG(group_avg) AS avg_of_avgs FROM (SELECT AVG(e.fillcount) AS group_avg FROM orderexecutions e JOIN orders o ON o.recordvault = e.ordersmark WHERE CAST(e.expirespot AS TEXT) BETWEEN '2025-02-28 08:29:46.10496' AND '2025-03-13 08:29:46.068533' GROUP BY e.ordersmark, o.orderflow) g WHERE group_avg IS NOT NULL

assumptions.assumption: The text comparison is a plain string BETWEEN (inclusive) on expirespot cast to text, as the request states, so no timestamp parsing is applied.
If several orders share the same recordvault, the join would repeat executions. recordvault is treated as unique, as the documentation says.
